built_from: git archive of CatholicGPT at the version commit c709287 (clean tree)
published_as: GitHub Release v1.8.30 only (APK above GitHub's 100 MiB file limit, not copied to dist/)
changes: Landscape foundations (T-047, Codex): compact header band instead of the 236 dp art header on phones in landscape, side navigation rail, side sheets, two-column dialogs; readers without art (owner decision, P9).
Visible keyboard focus ring on every control, and the system 'Remove animations' setting is now honoured app-wide; focused items never hide under the floating dock.
Spanish bundled Bible: 3,069 verses no longer show a space before punctuation (e.g. 'era Dios .'); English: 23 verses (T-060).
Images for 5 more Marian devotions and emblems for the 26 religious orders that still showed a monogram (T-061).
Content for 'Other chaplets' (55 chaplets with images) is bundled but not yet visible: its screen comes with T-057.
tests: Full unit suite on the merged tree: 1181 tests, 1 known failure (ExampleRobolectricTest: app_name under the preview init script), 7 skipped
known_limitations: Not tested on a physical phone.
Landscape screens other than the shared foundations are redesigned in L1-L7 (next releases).
